name: Magic Seven Discovery
competency: Understanding 3D opposite faces, spatial rotation, and complements of 7 as a fun mystery discovery rather than an addition drill
ncertStandard: Grade 1 & 2 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 5 (Shapes & Spatial Solids)
overview: Children discover that opposite faces on a standard playing die always equal 7. Rolling the die randomly reveals a top face, and the child deduces the hidden bottom face (1/6, 2/5, 3/4) with 3D flip inspection and peek mirror hints.
learningOutcomes: Identify opposite pairs on 3D cubes/dice that sum to 7
Strengthen spatial perspective and mental rotation
Discover number complements through playful mystery rather than equation worksheets
Experience 3D die flips and dynamic verification

levels.name: Dice Detective
levels.description: Throw the die and guess the opposite face with peek mirror clues

levels.name: Opposite Face Master
levels.description: Faster deductive rolls with opposite face badges
